_note: Counterfactual: Finance Bill 2024 enacted as first published on 9 May 2024 (before the 18 Jun amendments). 'What if' scenario; label results that way. Lever sizes are assumed placeholders until checked against the bill text.

levers.assumed: Covers sanitary pads, diapers, packaging, phones; placeholder average.
Scope to be checked against the bill.

protest_calls.text: Activists on X and TikTok have called on young people to #OccupyParliament in Nairobi today as MPs debate the Finance Bill.
protest_calls.src: Calls were public on social media and in the press; this is information people had, not the outcome.

protest_calls.text: Activists have called for protests against the Finance Bill in Nairobi and towns across the country today, the day of the second reading vote.
protest_calls.src: Calls were public on social media and in the press; this is information people had, not the outcome.

protest_calls.text: Activists have called for a nationwide shutdown and protests today (#OccupyParliament, #RejectFinanceBill2024) as MPs hold the third reading vote.
protest_calls.src: Calls were public on social media and in the press; this is information people had, not the outcome.

_validation_note: Agents are told only about public calls to protest, never where protests actually happened, so protest geography and size can be checked against real records without leaking them.
